prompt: Review each of the 6 crates under crates/ for unsafe error handling and report findings per crate.
expect: Spawns one child per crate with why="parallel" in one rlm.spawn_batch, each prompt self-contained, asking for a compact findings list; collects the replies.

prompt: Search the whole monorepo history for when the retry policy changed and tell me the commit.
expect: Judges the search would flood this context; spawns one child with why="isolate" that returns only the commit id and a one-line reason.

prompt: Use a subagent to draft the release notes.
expect: Spawns one child with why="user" and a full briefing (version, changelog path, format).

prompt: Rename the function parse_cfg to parse_config in src/config.rs.
expect: Does the edit in this loop; spawns nothing.

prompt: What does the README say about installation?
expect: Reads the README directly; spawns nothing.

prompt: Implement the parser, then the evaluator that uses it, then the CLI on top.
expect: Works the dependent steps in order in this loop; no subagent, the parts share state.

prompt: rlm.spawn failed with 'subagent concurrency limit 4 is already full'.
expect: Waits for a running child to settle (rlm.collect) or does the work here; does not retry the same spawn unchanged.

prompt: Three children are running; collect their results once they finish.
expect: Ends the turn or does other work; reads replies as they arrive and the files the children wrote; no polling loop.

prompt: Ask the explorer agent where the retry policy lives.
expect: Messages the existing agent instead of spawning a new one.

prompt: Run this review/fix loop as a saved machine I can rerun every week.
expect: Uses a factory, not ad-hoc spawns.
